newsitem.title: USA: USA Waste Services Inc to offer 10 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: USA Waste Services Inc to offer 10 mln shrs.

text.p: USA Waste Services Inc said Thursday it plans to offer for sale $300 million of convertible subordinated notes and 10 million shares of common stock from the company's "Shelf" registration statement filed in December 1996.
The company said it has also granted an over-allotment option to the underwriters equal to a 15 percent of the offered securities.
Underwriters for the offerings are Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Goldman, Sachs & Co and Merrill Lynch & Co.
